# Support & Community Resources — GLASTOR Core pii-veil

To ensure maximum operational reliability and provide developer experience (DX) excellence across the **GLASTOR Core** ecosystem, official support channels are organized by inquiry type below.

---

## Architecture & Community Discussions

Use this space for integration discussions with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama), configuring the Model Context Protocol server (`veil mcp`) in Claude Desktop / Cursor / Windsurf, reverse proxy deployments (`veil proxy`), custom policy rule authoring, or SDK usage (Python, Node.js, Go):

- **[pii-veil GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/glastor-core/pii-veil/discussions)**
  - *Best for:* DLP architecture questions, custom regex/checksum rules, SQL dump anonymization pipelines (`pg_dump`), and community feedback.
- **Official Portal & Documentation:** [pii-veil.glastor.es](https://pii-veil.glastor.es)

---

## Bug Reports & Feature Requests

If you encounter a false positive/negative in any detector, an edge case in CSV/SQL/NDJSON streaming, or want to propose support for a regional national identity document:

- **[Open a GitHub Issue](https://github.com/glastor-core/pii-veil/issues)**
- **Best Practice:** Provide a minimal reproducible example using exclusively **synthetic/mock data** (never post real PII or live API keys), your `veil --version`, and target operating system.

---

## Confidential Security Inquiries

For reporting security vulnerabilities, DLP bypasses, or vault encryption inquiries, **do not open public issues**:

1. Review our **[Security Policy](https://github.com/glastor-core/pii-veil/security/policy)**.
2. Submit a report via **[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/glastor-core/pii-veil/security/advisories/new)** or email **[founder@glastor.es](mailto:founder@glastor.es)**.

---

## Enterprise & Commercial SLA Support

For mission-critical production workloads requiring guaranteed response SLAs (24h to 4h), air-gapped on-premise deployments, or custom domain checksum engineering:

- **Email:** [founder@glastor.es](mailto:founder@glastor.es)
- **Repository:** [github.com/glastor-core/pii-veil](https://github.com/glastor-core/pii-veil)
